description: This file implements the methods for the 'TaskPool' class within a multithreading/event-driven system, managing tasks and event handling in a network agent context. It includes methods for adding tasks, running tasks with time limits, sending and handling events, and processing messages. The code appears to be integral to task scheduling and event dispatching in the software project.

classes.name: TaskPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of tasks, their events, and execution scheduling, providing APIs to add tasks, run scheduled tasks within a time limit, and dispatch events.
